end.summary:
Practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers in words and numerals.
Worked with place values in 120, 6042, 42, 2345, and 8614.
Diya identified digits in thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones in some examples.
Mixed up place-value writing by joining spoken parts and treating digits as face values; these were not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place-value columns and converting number words to numerals with Diya. Diya correctly identified that 6042 has 6 thousands, 0 hundreds, 4 tens, and 2 ones, and explained 42 as 4 tens and 2 ones. They mixed up how the parts of a spoken number fit into the thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones columns, and this was not corrected by the end. At home, practise one number at a time using a place-value chart, placing each digit in its column before writing the numeral.
